explication: tldraw is an extensible React infinite-canvas SDK, with tldraw.com and starter applications built around it. The principal workflow is: a user interacts with a browser canvas, the editor interprets pointer actions into shape and camera changes, and the application renders or persists the resulting document. The repository also supports custom tools/shapes, multiplayer synchronization, AI-oriented canvas applications, local persistence, and analytics. This map emphasizes sampled runtime code; several broader capabilities are represented from the README and tree but their internal wiring was not sampled.
